meta.geometrySource: Natural Earth, through @d3-maps/atlas 1.0.0 (110m); boundaries are cartographic context, not an endorsement of territorial claims.
meta.citySource: Natural Earth 50m populated places; mapped places with POP_MAX >= 100000 or ADM0CAP = 1. Static generalized dataset, not a current population census.
meta.cityDistance: Great-circle distance from H3 center to nearest mapped city point; not road or travel distance.
meta.coastDistance: Approximate minimum spherical distance from H3 center to any segment of the generalized Natural Earth 110m coastline; small islands and fine coast detail may be omitted.
meta.containment: Cell center falls within a published land country polygon; Antarctica excluded from cells, retained as outline. Small islands can lack cell centers. Mixed land/ocean cells are retained.
meta.coordinateOrder: Longitude, latitude. Closed cell rings are clockwise for d3-geo. Numeric precision: centroid 4 decimals, boundaries 3 decimals.
